alt: A living room viewed from a doorway in five distinct design styles: Moroccan with carved plaster and zellige tile, Scandinavian with white plaster and pale ash, Art Deco with black marble and walnut, wabi-sabi with weathered timber and raw plaster, Parisian with aged oak and silk plaster.
text:
same room, five languages.

the walls change, everything shifts. zellige and plaster, white ash, black marble, weathered timber, aged oak—each material language remakes the entire room. the architecture holds. everything else transforms.

the second one is the one i keep coming back to.

#interiorarchitecture #materialculture #designlanguage #spaceandform #designgrammar
